title: Sloga Uppsala capture Superettan title
description: Wetterbygden - Sloga Uppsala 74-76 Sloga Uppsala conquered Superettan title. They outscored Wetterbygden to sweep the Finals. The guests took control from the first minutes by winning first half. But Wetterbygden won third quarter 22-14. However it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. Axel Nordstrom (194-1991) scored 23 points, 7 rebounds and 4 assists to lead the charge for the winners and Bosnian-North Macedonian center Marko Dujkovic (226-1990) chipped in 14 points and 15 rebounds during the contest. Guard Albin Eriksson (189-1996) responded with 25 points (was perfect 10-for-10 from the free throw line !!!) and guard Isak Homelius (194-2006) scored 16 points. Four Wetterbygden players scored in double figures. Wetterbygden's coach Mamoun Keirawan tried various players' combinations and tested in total eleven players in this game, but that didn't help.
